description: Ba₄NaSb₃O₁₂ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Im̅3m space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SbO₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.29 Å. Ba is bonded to twelve O atoms to form BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and faces with six equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. There are six shorter (2.97 Å) and six longer (2.98 Å) Ba-O bond lengths. Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and faces with eight equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (1.92 Å) and four longer (2.10 Å) Sb-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na, four equivalent Ba, and one Sb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Ba and two equivalent Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and face-sharing OBa₄Sb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-60°.
